summary: The old harness blocks the newly added built-in PRIORITY_UPDATE receive path. Its missing local priority setting also blocked request Priority field handling before the change and continues to block it afterward.

claims.necessity_reason: The added built-in receive branch requires the PRIORITY_UPDATE extension mask and local NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES setting before it can process a frame.

before.requirement: Built-in server reception of PRIORITY_UPDATE through session_process_priority_update_frame.
before.reason: The preimage receiver has no built-in PRIORITY_UPDATE dispatch for this route.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The preimage's unknown-frame handling resets the inbound frame.

after.requirement: Enable built-in PRIORITY_UPDATE reception and advertise local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1.
after.reason: The null-option server has no built-in extension mask, and submitting only MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS sets pending_no_rfc7540_priorities to 0. The receive guard therefore skips the added processor.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The built-in extension mask is copied only from a supplied option.
Omitting the local priority setting assigns the pending value 0.
This is the newly added processing route behind the receive guard.

claims.comparison_reason: The specified built-in receive behavior was added after the preimage; the unchanged harness cannot satisfy its two setup requirements.

claims.necessity_reason: Both versions gate request Priority field parsing and stream priority application on the local NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES mode.

before.requirement: Advertise local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so a received request Priority field can set and apply extensible priority.
before.reason: The preimage already parses request Priority fields only for streams in NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES mode. The harness omits the local setting, so its request streams do not enter that mode.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The preimage applies the parsed priority only for a stream bearing the mode flag.
Omitting the local priority setting assigns pending_no_rfc7540_priorities to 0.

after.requirement: Advertise local SETTINGS_NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 so a received request Priority field can set the new PRIORITY flag and apply its parsed value.
after.reason: The changed parser remains gated on the stream's NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES flag. The unchanged harness omits the setting, so the new PRIORITY flag is never set through this route and the parsed value is not applied.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: After the change, stream priority application additionally requires the new PRIORITY flag.
The unchanged settings logic assigns the pending value 0 when the setting is omitted.

claims.comparison_reason: The same omitted local setting blocks the request Priority field route before and after the change. The added PRIORITY flag changes downstream behavior but does not remove that prerequisite.
